name: Article 1 – § 1 – point 6; Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 – Article 16ba – After point 5 – 175
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 261/2004, (EC) No 1107/2006, (EU) No 1177/2010, (EU) No 181/2011 and (EU) 2021/782 as regards enforcement of passenger rights in the Union
part_text: 5a. When carrying out the monitoring activities referred to in this Article and when requesting documents and information from air carriers, airport managing bodies and intermediaries, national enforcement bodies shall respect the principle of proportionality and the rights of defence of the undertakings concerned. In particular: (a) requests for documents and information shall state their legal basis and purpose, shall be limited to what is necessary for that purpose and shall set a time limit for reply of not less than one month, save in urgent cases duly justified; (b) unannounced inspections of premises that are not open to the public shall be carried out only where there are reasonable grounds to suspect an infringement and prior notice would be likely to jeopardise the effectiveness of the inspection; (c) business secrets and other confidential information obtained in the course of monitoring activities shall be protected and shall be used only for the purpose for which they were obtained; (d) before requiring an action plan under paragraph 5 or imposing a penalty, the national enforcement body shall inform the undertaking concerned of its findings in writing and give it the opportunity to submit its observations within a reasonable period; (e) decisions of national enforcement bodies shall state the reasons on which they are based and shall be subject to an effective judicial remedy.
